research_window.note: Continuous scan from the prior accepted open-branch boundary. The election alert, measles update and USDA follow-up were published within the exact window. The producer-price release and USDA announcement surfaced during this scan but predated the boundary and are explicitly treated as late-indexed discoveries. One record was added and three stable records materially refreshed.

publication_authorization: Authorized scheduled maintenance of the National Trump Record. Publication remains subject to deterministic validation, CI and the repository’s final human acceptance gate; no AI output is treated as evidence.

source_inspections.origin_group: Federal Bureau of Investigation and Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
source_inspections.evidence_extract: FBI and CISA issued alert I-101626-PSA on October 16 warning that phishing, smishing and AI-enabled deepfakes may target election officials, candidates and political organizations during the 2026 midterms. The alert explains why those actors are attractive targets and recommends phishing-resistant multifactor authentication, verification through known channels and content credentials; it does not report a completed breach.
source_inspections.hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact normalized evidence extract retained below, not a claim of hashing the publisher’s complete webpage.

source_inspections.evidence_extract: Reuters reported at 15:07 UTC on October 16 that the FBI and CISA urged election officials and the public to guard against bogus emails and text messages aimed at credentials and sensitive data, independently confirming the federal alert and its election-security context.
source_inspections.hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact normalized evidence extract retained below, not a claim of hashing the publisher’s complete webpage.

source_inspections.evidence_extract: USDA announced a $3.3 billion Rural Utilities Service loan to Oglethorpe Power for the Smarr Combined-Cycle facility, calling it the largest RUS loan. USDA said Oglethorpe is owned by 38 distribution cooperatives serving nearly five million people and presented lower-cost financing, reliability and affordability as intended benefits.

source_inspections.evidence_extract: Oglethorpe’s SEC-filed investor briefing listed $3.324 billion for Smarr as conditionally committed August 6, requiring documentation, with $0 advanced and initial funding expected by 2028. The filing prevents treating the public announcement as completed disbursement.
